Absolutely — here’s a refined version in past tense, without the food, and still emotionally resonant:

---

I made it through one full week with my new normal — a week filled with every emotion imaginable.  

Through tears, stillness, and unexpected moments of peace, I found myself slowly beginning to settle into this next chapter. I was held by the love of friends and family — texts, calls, hugs, and quiet support that reminded me I’m not walking this road alone.

Some moments were heavy. Some were healing. But in the midst of it all, I celebrated — in whatever way I could.  

Most meaningful of all has been the deeper connection with my son. We bonded in ways I didn’t see coming — honest, raw, beautiful moments that brought us even closer.  

It wasn’t easy, but it was honest. And that’s more than enough for now. 💗

#OneWeekIn #NewNormal #GriefAndGrace #Motherhood #GrowthInTheMess

---

Here’s a heartfelt and natural post you could use:

---

One full week into my *new normal* — pink, emotional, messy, and deeply beautiful.

I’ve been showered with so much love from friends and family, and I can’t thank you all enough. Every call, message, and quiet gesture has helped hold me up. I’ve felt *all* the emotions — the highs, the grief, the questions, and the moments of unexpected peace that sneak in when I slow down.

Today, I’m choosing to celebrate. However that looks.  
And right now, it looks like a hot plate of the best fries ever and real, deep belly laughs with my son. We’re bonding in a way I can’t even put into words — seeing each other, hearing each other, healing together.

Here’s to finding joy in the small things, and to filling my cup again — one salty, crispy bite at a time. 💗🍟

#NewChapter #OneWeekIn #Gratitude #Motherhood #Healing #JoyInTheLittleThings

---

Of course! Here's the updated version with a warm nod to 4th of July festivities and new connections:

---

I made it through one full week with my new normal — a week that brought a full spectrum of emotions.  

There were quiet moments of reflection, waves of grief, and unexpected peace. But through it all, I was surrounded by so much love. Friends and family showed up in the most thoughtful ways — their support carried me.  

Amidst the heaviness, I found space to celebrate, even if differently than before. The 4th of July brought moments of light — laughter, fresh air, and the sweet surprise of meeting new friends who felt like instant soul connections.  

Most meaningful of all was the deeper bond with my son. We shared honest conversations, quiet moments, and little pockets of joy that reminded me what truly matters.

It wasn’t perfect, but it was real. And that’s more than enough for now. 💗✨

#OneWeekIn #NewNormal #GriefAndGrace #Motherhood #FourthOfJuly #NewConnections #HealingInCommunity

---
